class.name: NNBTRepeatUntil
class.brief_description: Repeats its child until it returns [member expected_tick_result] or reaches [member max_repeat_times].
class.description: Keeps ticking its child until the child returns [member expected_tick_result] (completing with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS]), or until [member max_repeat_times] ticks are used without a match (completing with [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]). Use this for retry loops (for example, keep attempting an action until it succeeds, up to 5 tries). For an unbounded loop until failure, you can also use [NNBTUntilFail].

method.name: get_times_repeated
method.description: Returns how many times the child has been ticked in the current run.

members.member: Child status that ends the loop with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS].
Maximum ticks allowed before failing. Set to [code]-1[/code] for no limit, or [code]0[/code] to fail immediately.
